title: Finite sticker stock and coin model
problem: The site has no auditable draw stock, sticker catalog, or free coin ledger.
action_items: Create roughly 40 original ink stickers across project, tool, music and mascot themes, including Spark, Airflow and DuckDB; assign rarity and stable IDs.
Implement finite per-tier stock with draws without replacement, stable persisted batch state, duplicate counts, honest remaining/total odds, and a new batch only after exhaustion.
Implement one coin per distinct route per local day with a daily cap, one-time find rewards, and a pure Konami matcher; validate versioned storage and recover from malformed or denied storage.
Test seeded draws, stock exhaustion, odds after every draw, duplicate and reload behavior, daily boundary/cap, and typing-safe sequence matching; record real/fake boundaries in task evidence.
acceptance_criteria: Finite stock is consumed exactly once per paid-with-earned-coin draw; displayed odds equal the remaining stock ratio, duplicates are tracked, and page exploration earns bounded free coins. Corrupt or blocked storage remains usable.

title: Gashapon machine and Play entry
problem: Visitors cannot spend earned paper coins in a tactile accessible capsule machine.
action_items: Read the relevant installed Next route/client guide and build /play/gashapon plus a Play entry without changing pinned global nav labels.
Draw the SVG machine and implement captured pointer-angle crank turns, 30-degree clicks, one full turn per draw, and Space/Enter equivalent with no double spend.

Animate a rolling capsule and crack reveal, with immediate reveal under reduced motion. Add crank, drop and crack cues using the existing sound switch and shared context; keep sound off until enabled by user gesture.
Show the live remaining stock, percentages, rarity, and honest duplicate result. Add browser checks for pointer, keyboard, stock, mute, reload and reduced motion; record evidence.
acceptance_criteria: A visitor can earn a coin, turn the crank by drag or keyboard, see a capsule crack into a sticker, and inspect accurate live odds. Sound follows the site switch and reduced motion skips the roll.

title: Sticker album and PNG export
problem: Collected stickers have no durable, placeable album or shareable image.
action_items: Build a sticker-book album with pointer drag and keyboard move/place controls, normalised 0–1 positions, labels, and a visible duplicate shelf.
Persist a versioned album in localStorage with safe parse/migration and memory fallback on denial; restore positions after reload.
Render every placed sticker and page decoration into a PNG blob for download and Web Share when supported; use deterministic canvas drawing and test nonblank content.
Give secret rare stickers animated CSS foil driven by pointer position with static foil under reduced motion; test storage corruption, reload, placement, PNG, and fallback.
acceptance_criteria: Visitors can place, move, reload and export collected stickers as a nonblank PNG; secret rares have foil treatment with a static reduced-motion state.

title: Hidden sticker hunt
problem: Exploration does not yet reveal the promised one-time hidden stickers.
action_items: Add tiny discoverable sticker spots to Notes, Sketches and the 404 route, each with keyboard access and a one-time claim tied to the shared collection store.
Register a Konami sequence listener that ignores input, textarea, select and editable targets, grants one hidden sticker and announces it accessibly.
Award the documented exploration coin once per eligible route/day without adding heavyweight code to every page; verify no repeated rewards across reloads.
Add browser checks for all four finds, one-time behavior, typing negative control, and Notes/Sketches/404 hydration.
acceptance_criteria: Notes, Sketches, 404 and the keyboard secret each yield their assigned sticker once; typing the sequence in a form does not trigger it.

title: Multi-bristle brush engine
problem: Shodo needs expressive brush marks rather than a uniform canvas line.
action_items: Implement deterministic 30–60 bristle state with ink load, offset and wear; sample pressure and speed, including a speed-only mouse/touch fallback, to set taper and deposition.
Drain ink per bristle to form dry streaks; expose explicit dip/reload and seedable paper-fibre noise for directional bleed after each stroke.
Use bounded sample/bristle work and capped device pixel ratio; expose a pure deposition plan and a thin canvas renderer with procedural washi texture.
Test slow/fast taper, pressure, dry-out, reload, fibre determinism, clipping and work budgets with fixtures; record the real browser rendering boundary.
acceptance_criteria: Brush output varies with pressure and speed, visibly dries into streaks, reloads on dip, and bleeds along reproducible fibres within bounded work.

title: Daily kanji and gentle scoring
problem: The desk has no licensed stroke ghost, daily selection or feedback model.
action_items: Bundle a curated KanjiVG subset with source attribution and CC BY-SA 3.0 notice; use local stroke polylines with no runtime fetch.
Choose the local-date daily kanji deterministically, draw a faint ordered ghost, and score resampled user strokes for shape and order with generous tolerances.
Return encouraging stars and per-stroke hints without blocking export; test exact trace, reversed order, far-off mark, missing strokes, and date boundary.
Check that data and attribution ship in the repository and retain the license information in the exported-sheet drawing plan.
acceptance_criteria: A bundled daily kanji has an ordered ghost and attributed source; correct, reversed and distant strokes receive distinct gentle feedback without blocking a sheet.

title: Shodo desk, seal and export
problem: Visitors cannot practice, sign or keep a Shodo sheet.
action_items: Read the installed Next guide and build /play/shodo with a responsive washi canvas, ordered ghost, brush dip, gentle score, pen pressure, mouse/touch fallback and keyboard-accessible controls.

Use pm-285's pure Hanko seal if it exists at integration; otherwise implement a compatible static vermilion visitor-name seal locally, without waiting on another plan. Gate the stamp cue through the existing sound switch.
Composite paper, ghost choice, ink, attribution and seal to a PNG blob, offer download and Web Share when available, and keep visitor text on device.
Add browser checks for nonblank ink and PNG, dry/reload, deliberate wrong order, sealing, denied storage, mobile touch, mute and reduced motion; record evidence.
acceptance_criteria: A visitor can trace the daily ghost with a real brush feel, receive gentle feedback, reload ink, sign the sheet, and download or share a composed PNG with attribution.

title: Brush headings and ensō loader
problem: The requested brush language is confined to Shodo instead of appearing across the site.
action_items: Add an accessible brush-reveal heading wrapper to selected site sections using the shared brush path; keep the actual heading text in the DOM and compatible with RisoText.
Add a lightweight ensō loader using one circular brush stroke and accessible status text; avoid repeated animation or hidden content when motion is reduced.
Provide instant fully revealed headings and a static ensō under reduced motion; check dark/light legibility, loading teardown and no layout jump.
Extend browser tests for selected headings, loader, reduced motion and semantic heading names, and run full regression gates.
acceptance_criteria: Selected section headings reveal with the brush and the ensō loader appears during loading; both preserve accessible text and show a static final state under reduced motion.
